West Coast Port Employers Warn of Possible Strike at Los Angeles, Long Beach

Contract talks with 250 security guards stall ahead of midnight Friday deadline, threatening peak holiday cargo flows

By

West Coast port employers are warning of a possible strike at the nation’s busiest container-port complex as soon as Saturday.

The Pacific Maritime Association said Wednesday it was struggling to reach a labor deal with a union local that represents 250 security guards at the ports of Los Angeles and Long Beach ahead of the current contract’s expiration at 12:01 a.m. on Saturday.
